description: This file defines the 'BankTransfer' class, a controller for handling bank transfer payments in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for displaying payment instructions (index) and confirming payments (confirm).

classes.name: BankTransfer
classes.description: Controller class for handling bank transfer payment method in the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, prepares payment instructions view with bank details and language info, then returns the view template.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the confirmation of bank transfer payment, updates order history with a custom message, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.
